title: Your Next Five Moves
author: Patrick Bet-David with Greg Dinkin
blurb: Patrick Bet-David, who rose from immigrant roots to found a large financial services firm, argues that success in business comes from thinking like a chess player. Most people react to the next move. Winners anticipate several moves ahead. The book is organized around five areas to master. First, know yourself: what you truly want, who you are, and the person you are trying to become. Second, sharpen your ability to reason, so you can process problems calmly and make sound decisions. Third, build a strategy to grow. Fourth, assemble and lead the right team, with clear values and accountability. Fifth, learn power plays that let smaller players outmaneuver bigger ones. Throughout, Bet-David blends personal stories with practical frameworks, insisting that strategy is a learnable skill rather than a talent.
